title: Brandon Sanderson - Cosmere
use_cases: Use when building a multi-series fantasy universe to ensure cohesive lore.
Implement when needing continuity across multiple books and authors.
Configure when drafting planet-specific physical laws for a setting.
Use when creating hard magic systems with explicit rules for each world.
Design when documenting cosmology that connects interconnected series.
content:
What Sanderson documents: • Detailed hard magic systems with specific rules for each world • Shared cosmology connecting all series • Cross-series character appearances requiring continuity • Physical laws of each planet • Cultural development informed by magic system

Approach: Publishes partial world bibles as appendices. Maintains internal full documentation. Has continuity team checking each book against established canon.

Lesson: For complex multi-series worlds, professional continuity checking is essential. Document everything and have team verify consistency.
